title: Boku no Hero Academia 6th Season
content:
This has undoubtedly been the greatest season of the franchise. People kept calling it mid, myself included, but it’s about time I discarded my bigoted bias against the franchise. My Hero Academia is okay, but season six is a great modern Shounen extravaganza.

One very popular criticism the franchise gets is how of a cookie-cutter all of the characters are, save for maybe Endeavor. This was a huge checkpoint in my opinion. Not just for Midoriya and his friends, the villains were in my opinion had more spotlights and shine. Especially Shigaraki.

I’m sure it’s not just me, the show has had a darker shifte during thecourse of this season, for the better I think.

Overall 8.7/10.
